description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 3.
